local_hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 16 GB unified memory
status: PaddleOCR-VL, GLM and Monkey completed all eight shared-crop trials; DeepSeek excluded; no independent accuracy labels
memory_note: 16-bit weights alone require approximately 2 GB per billion parameters. Vision activations, decoder KV cache, runtime and OS memory are additional. Quantization changes logits and must be treated as a separate confidence experiment.

candidates.name: DeepSeek-OCR-2
candidates.status: Excluded at user request; not downloaded or tested

confidence_adapter_contract.input: Shared source crop and its SHA256; preserve engine-specific preprocessing and task prompt in settings
confidence_adapter_contract.output: Text, emitted token IDs, selected original logits/probabilities, alternatives where available, stop reason, wall time, and failures
confidence_adapter_contract.policy: No prompted self-confidence. Expose unmodified raw logits before any sampling processors; normalize in FP32 without changing greedy decoding. Separate markup-token summaries from content summaries when structure markup is emitted. Validate text equivalence with and without instrumentation. Do not claim raw scores are comparable across engines.

size_note: Counts include downloaded recognition checkpoint and configuration/tokenizer files. Monkey 1.2B naming does not describe all vision weights. User permits runtime memory above 4 GB.
